BREAK 1 — WRONG RADIUS (fatal, pure arithmetic). Theorem 3.10 lives at relative distance (ell/(ell+1))(1-rho-eta). At ell=3, rho=1/2 the ell=3 generalized-Singleton point is delta = (3/4)(1/2) = 3/8, i.e. AGREEMENT 5n/8.
